en.topic_title: Hong Kong catches nearly 110,000 live rats in first nine months of 2026
en.topic_summary:
The Hong Kong government has caught nearly 110,000 live rats and collected over 20,000 dead ones in the first nine months of this year as the city steps up efforts to combat rodent infestation. 



Food and Environmental Hygiene Department. File photo: GovHK.



The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department told local media in a written response that from January to September, staff caught 109,087 live rats, 20 per cent more than in the same period last year.
